```artifact
Feature: System Access and User Management

  Scenario: System is available on specified pin codes
  Given the system is configured with the Parameter Control File
  When a user attempts to access the system from a non-specified pin code
  Then the system should deny access

  Scenario Outline: System access on specified pin codes
  Examples:
    | Pin Code | Expected Result |
    | 1234     | Access granted    |
    | 5678     | Access denied     |
    | 9012     | Access denied     |

  Scenario: User login
  Given a user is registered in the system
  When the user attempts to login with valid credentials
  Then access to the system is granted

  Scenario Outline: User login
  Examples:
    | User ID | Password | Expected Result |
    | User1   | Pass123  | Access granted    |
    | User2   | Pass456  | Access denied     |
    | User3   | Pass789  | Access denied     |

  Scenario: Doctor-Speciality linkage
  Given a doctor is registered in the system
  When the doctor attempts to link to a speciality
  Then the link is established if the speciality exists

  Scenario Outline: Doctor-Speciality linkage
  Examples:
    | Doctor ID | Speciality | Expected Result |
    | Doc1     | Speciality1 | Link established    |
    | Doc2     | Speciality2 | Link established    |
    | Doc3     | Speciality3 | Link denied     |

  Scenario: Patient registration
  Given a patient is not registered in the system
  When the patient attempts to register with valid details
  Then the patient is registered and a unique id is generated

  Scenario Outline: Patient registration
  Examples:
    | Patient Name | Patient ID | Expected Result |
    | Patient1     | ID123456   | Registered        |
    | Patient2     | ID234567   | Registered        |
    | Patient3     | ID345678   | Registered        |

  Scenario: Consultation request
  Given a patient is registered in the system
  When the patient attempts to request a consultation
  Then the request is linked to the patient's speciality

  Scenario Outline: Consultation request
  Examples:
    | Patient ID | Speciality | Expected Result |
    | ID123456   | Speciality1 | Request linked    |
    | ID234567   | Speciality2 | Request linked    |
    | ID345678   | Speciality3 | Request denied     |

```
